metadata.purpose: Emit each admitted value, project it to an inner Observable, and recursively feed inner values back through the same expansion policy.

cardinality.signature: expand : (T! x Index! -> T*) -> T* -> T*
conditions: Every admitted outer or recursive inner value is emitted before its projection is subscribed.
Unbounded profile admits every value immediately; no expansion queue is formed.
Outer completion waits for all admitted recursive inners and buffered values.
Cω counts next values; terminal notifications, cancellation and resource release are separate obligations.

scope.callbacks: Projection is external: one correlated project(value,index) invocation per admitted value; modeled returns name Observable source tokens.
scope.time: No scheduler in the accepted profiles. Source/inner delivery order supplies time.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant projection outcomes and inner notifications; synchronous setup-time inner emissions are characterized only by native tests, not forced into the pure event model.
exclusions: Deprecated scheduler argument, arbitrary ObservableInput conversion, concurrency values other than 1 or unbounded.
Projection/observer/finalizer reentrancy and cancellation inside notification delivery.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire only the original outer source; recursive inner subscriptions arise from admitted projection returns.

ownership.sharing: No sharing is introduced; each result subscription owns independent state and resources.
ownership.reset: A fresh result subscription starts from Unsubscribed; Closed rejects all later model events.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Commit next state, then interpret ordered actions. Callback actions are requests to external user functions, never executed by the pure model.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between fully resolved reactions; cancellation releases owned work and emits no synthetic completion.
